_comment: SCENE FILE — the publisher splash, and the scene the application BOOTS into. The `tree` below is the arrangement — one full-bleed `splash` component (the Rust widgets kind that owns all drawing). The PAIR SCRIPT (scripts/TegLogo.lua) is a module like every pair script: its arrange() sets the splash node's properties (the image and the fade timeline) and its react() maps the fired signals to the `next`/`exit` intents. The `exits` map below is the ROUTING DATA for those intents: `next` = the timeline completed or the player confirmed; `exit` = the player backed out (Cancel/Esc). `boot` marks the one scene the application starts in.
